1.

Our time is in Thy hand, How sweet it is, Father, That Thou our life, our soul, our all Dost bear in Thy hands.

2.

Our time is in Thy hand, Whatever it may give us Of sorrow, of darkness, joy and light, In all Thy grace we see.

3.

Our time is in Thy hand, We fear no more. The Father who chastens, loves, What comfort it gives the heart!

4.

Our time is in Thy hand, Behold, Jesus, once dead, He lives now and leads us With the Shepherd’s tender support.

5.

Our time is in Thy hand, And our Advocate Is Christ. None can separate Us from Thy love any more.

6.

Our time is in Thy hand, May we not forget it! Soon we shall leave the land of sorrow And see Thy glory.
